added.title: Added to a contract
added.body: You were added to contract {{contractCode}} for {{roomName}} in {{buildingName}}.

left.title: Contract leave date recorded
left.body: The leave date for {{memberName}} on contract {{contractCode}} was recorded as {{leftOn}}.

locked.title: Account locked
locked.body: Your account has been locked. You can still view notifications.

unlocked.title: Account unlocked
unlocked.body: Your account has been unlocked. You can continue using the service.

created.title: New issue
created.body: A new issue is ready to review.

cancelled.title: Issue cancelled
cancelled.body: An issue report has been cancelled.

withdrawn.title: Roommate invitation withdrawn
withdrawn.body: {{actorName}} withdrew the roommate invitation sent to you.

decisionRequired.title: Action required on suspended contracts
decisionRequired.body: Your account has been unlocked. Please choose to restore or terminate suspended contracts.

restored.title: Contract restored
restored.body: The lease contract has been restored to active status.

terminated.title: Contract terminated
terminated.body: The lease contract has been terminated following suspension.

suspended.title: Contract suspended
suspended.body: The contract has been suspended due to landlord account lock.

preferences.title: Notification settings
preferences.description: Choose which notification groups reach your devices and appear as in-app web alerts. Inbox notifications remain available when these channels are off.
